nodes.label: Taxonomy
nodes.question: What is the concept of the "right to repair" in empowering sustainable consumption?
nodes.answer: The "right to repair" refers to consumers' ability to fix and maintain their products, extending their lifespan and reducing waste.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Repair cafes_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: How can giving consumers the "right to repair" empower sustainable consumption?
nodes.answer: By allowing consumers to repair their products, they can reduce the need for new purchases, leading to less waste and a more sustainable lifestyle.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Zero-waste initiatives|Repair cafes_qna_002
nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How can companies use collection points in shops to attract customers and encourage the purchase of new items?
nodes.answer: Companies can use collection points in shops to urge customers to empty their closets and offer repair or refurbishing services at competitive prices.
